references.title: Parliament House, tree-free aerial showing both complete lower wings, Helsinki City Museum architecture record, image2
Parliament official aerial, Lev Karavanov / Mostphotos

openedReferences.observation: Tree-free oblique aerial shows the complete south lower front wing with eleven tall round-arched openings, a thin top band and stone courses. Source plane extent/orientation matches this wing beyond the main stairs.
Contemporary official aerial corroborates extant round arches and pink-gray stone; canopy obscures several exact bay positions, so historical tree-free view supplies the complete count.

southLowerWing.openingArrangement: One evenly spaced row; original flat glazing/grid approximation, not a claim about which doors are open or which interiors exist.
southLowerWing.surface: Pink-gray granite coursing and narrow top stone band.

approximations: Metre positions, aperture widths/heights, glazing subdivisions and stone colour/joints are authored visual approximations from opened reference and source dimensions.
No copied reference pixels, tree silhouettes, painted reflections or added mesh geometry.
Source solid wall/collision remains; this chart does not create an enterable building.
Textureless distant source triangles receive a corner-colour approximation only, not full window detail.
